benchmark: B5 CSS versus matched absolute Rosenau-Hyman comparator
isolated_propagation: PASS all p=1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2 in short screen; p=1.5 refinement passes
qualifications: CSS eta=0.05 h^3 is too aggressive through contact; fixed-eta h convergence must precede eta->0.
Early post-contact CSS-RH separation is certified at T=1.2; a full T=6 vanishing-regularization CSS limit is not certified.
RH unfiltered long-time solution develops an increasingly oscillatory dispersive tail; strong convergence of that tail is not certified.
Smooth RH Pdot identity is not exact across the nonsmooth compacton interaction at the discrete level; use P change plus H/Casimir diagnostics.
